sections.shortTitle: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service Constitution Functions Powers Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

THE SINDH CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE
THE SINDH CRIMINAL
PROSECUTION SERVICE
(CONSTITUTION,
FUNCTIONS & POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
SINDH ACT NO. XIV OF 2014
KARACHI, THE 11TH JUNE, 2014.
AN
ACT
NO.PAS/Legis-B-10/2014- The
Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution,
Functions & Powers) (Amendment) Bill, 2014 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 25th
April, 2014 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 10th June, 2014 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh. to amend the Sindh
Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions & Powers) Act,2009.
Preamble.- WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions
& Powers) Act,2009, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and Commencement.- (1) This Act may be called the Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions
& Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2014.
(2)
It shall extend to the whole of Province of Sindh.
(3)
It shall come into force at once.
